'''2003 DPC Atlanta Matt Lush LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Lush]] at [[2003 DPC Atlanta]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Steve "BlackViper" Marshall (2003-02-09).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=27232 Classic "Hidden Base? What th-OH IT HURTS! IT BURNS! MAKE IT STOP! FOR THE LOVE OF GOD AAAAAAHH]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071219212414/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=27232 Internet Archive]</ref>
